description: Manually specified supported input semantics for every domain operation. Public parameter names remain the canonical catalog signatures; shared schemas include compatibility aliases and file-backed plan formats. Reserved options remain permissive only where the established handler ignores them.

anyOf.description: Reserved options retain previously accepted successful inputs; no undocumented fields affect execution.
Reserved read options; current handlers preserve unfiltered results.

attributes.description: CoNLL-U attribute text, a name/value mapping, or ordered entries. Null and empty collections clear the field; null mapping values are supported for opaque MISC flags.

split_spec_path.description: Optional UTF-8 JSON split membership: splits maps at least two labels to nonempty arrays of file paths or {file_path,sent_id} selectors from the current corpus.

output_format.description: SVG/HTML use offline built-in rendering. PNG/PDF require the verified render pack. JPEG/WebP return a prerequisite failure in the current profile.
